0.heading: Overview
refs: Mark 12:1 , In a parable of the vineyard let out to wicked husbandmen Christ foretells the reprobation of the Jews, and the calling of the Gentiles
Mark 12:13 , He avoids the snare of the Pharisees and Herodians about paying tribute to Caesar
Mark 12:18 , convicts the Sadducees of error, who denied the resurrection
Mark 12:28 , resolves the scribe, who questioned of the first commandment
Mark 12:35 , refutes the opinion that the scribes held of Christ
Mark 12:38 , bidding the people to beware of their ambition and hypocrisy
Mark 12:41 , and commends the poor widow for her two mites, above all.

24.heading: Do:
refs: As the five books of Moses were the only scriptures which the Sadducees admitted as Divine, our Lord confutes them by an appeal to these books, and proves that they were ignorant of those very writings which they professed to hold sacred. He not only rectified their opinions, but so explained the doctrine as to overthrow the erroneous decision of the Pharisees, that if two brothers married one woman, she should be restored at the resurrection to the first. Isa 8:20
